samples_reviewed.question_text: What shape has 4 sides where opposite sides are equal?
What shape has 3 sides and 3 corners?
What shape has 4 equal sides and 4 corners?
What shape has 4 equal sides and 4 corners?
What shape has 3 sides and 3 corners?
What shape has 4 equal sides and 4 corners?

competency_fulfillment.rationale: The competency's central verb is 'identify' shapes 'of different size and in different orientation', but all six samples are verbal attribute riddles, e.g. seed 42's 'What shape has 4 sides where opposite sides are equal?', with no mention of size or orientation anywhere in the text, so that specific named sub-skill is never textually evidenced.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: All three named shapes are directly quizzed across the six seeds -- rectangle (seed 42), triangle (seeds 43, 46), and square (seeds 44, 45, 50) -- giving full coverage of the competency's named shape set.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Attribute vocabulary such as 'sides', 'corners', and 'equal' in seed 44's 'What shape has 4 equal sides and 4 corners?' matches Grade 1 Quarter 1 introductory shape vocabulary.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Seeds 44 and 45 render byte-identical text, 'What shape has 4 equal sides and 4 corners?', and seeds 43 and 46 also duplicate each other, so across six samples only three distinct question stems actually appear.

competency_alignment.rationale: The read_mcq sample at seed 50 reuses the same riddle-style stem as the plain mcq at seed 44 rather than framing it as 'look at the shape shown', so the read-a-visual format doesn't add the size/orientation evidence the competency names.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: This is a shape-name competency with no numeric ceiling to exceed; side counts referenced, 3 for triangle and 4 for square/rectangle, are the complete and correct attribute scale for Grade 1 Quarter 1.
